messages:
Tomás Rivera: Quick follow-up — three recent postmortems show the same authz failure mode: transient token validation errors after rolling deploys AND intermittent loss of rotation audit events when secure-log is under load. Need owners, short mitigations, and a plan to make rotations durable.

Elena Park: Can we capture a canonical error/stack for the smokecheck? A one-line log would help bake tests.

Tomás Rivera: Example from staging logs:
```
ERROR auth.token: key fetch failed, jwk-cache miss, upstream=keystore-2/504, req=tx-f3c9
```

Marcus Hale: Two quick hypotheses: (1) JWK cache TTL too short / evicting during deploy; (2) rotation handler is fire-and-forget so backpressure to secure-log causes lost events.

Maya Chen: Proposal (10-day targets):
- Owner: Elena Park — post-deploy smokecheck that validates a signed token end-to-end against a canary replica + CI gating (due 2026-05-10)
- Owner: Marcus Hale — make rotation audit write blocking with circuit-breaker + idempotent retry (due 2026-05-14)
- Owner: Tomás Rivera — add JWK prefetch on startup and tie cache invalidation to rotation events (due 2026-05-08)
- Owner: Maya Chen — deploy authz incident dashboard and weekly digest alert (due 2026-05-06)
Ack please and we'll create tracker items.

Elena Park: ack. I'll implement a tiny smoke that requests a signed token from the new replica and validates it; run as a post-deploy job with a 10s timeout. Will open PR.

Marcus Hale: ack. I'll change rotation to synchronous write-with-ack to secure-log; add exponential backoff and a short circuit-breaker that pauses rotations and alerts if the sink is failing. Will include an integration test that simulates sink 429/503.

Tomás Rivera: ack. I'll add prefetch + bump JWK TTL and implement an event-based invalidation hook for rotations so services rotate atomically.

Maya Chen: Also proposing a 30-min monthly "authz pulse" to review trends and surface stuck owners. If you can't hit your ETA, post an update 48h before with scope or reassignment. Also planning a short canary + chaos failure test next week to validate the rotation changes.

Elena Park: I'll schedule the canary run and tag the staging chaos test.

Marcus Hale: I'll add a migration path so older rotations that used async writes get backfilled with confirmed audit events.

Maya Chen: Thanks all — I'll add these to the remediation tracker and ping 24h before the canary. :white_check_mark:
